FAQ

How do I restore my purchases?

Open the Shop and tap Restore purchases while signed in to the same Google Play account. Restoring re-applies Remove Ads, Riz Pass and the starter bundle; it does not give coins again.

How do I cancel Riz Pass?

Google Play > Profile > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions > Riz Pass > Cancel. Uninstalling the app does not cancel it.

How do I delete my data?

Settings > Delete my data in the app, or uninstall it. All game data is stored on your device only.

Is the spin wheel gambling?

No. Spins are free (one a day, plus optional rewarded-video spins). Nothing can be bought to spin, and prizes are virtual items with no cash value.
